control_description: Sanctions rule and named control owners in POL-02 and the POA&M

control_description: Risk register and BIA give the information controls depend on

control_description: Policies in the shared drive; reporting rule on cards at both offices

remediation: Brief staff at the September safety meeting

control_description: Partner questionnaire answered with this summary; incident contacts for the purchaser and partners in P08
gap: No standing security contact for partners or the seismic licensor
remediation: Name the Office Manager as security contact in partner and licensor correspondence

2026 risk analysis with SP 800-30 tables (25 risks)
Payment redirection and bank detail changes in the register (R-004); bank dual approval
gap: Call-back rule not yet in use
remediation: Call-back rule and monthly bank change report (POL-04 4.7)

control_description: Major changes trigger a risk update (POL-02 A.2)

remediation: Use A.2 for the SCADA host replacement

control_description: Independent assessment 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SSP to address P01 risks
gap: Most selected controls are partially implemented or planned
remediation: Complete the 2026 Q4 treatments

control_description: Office technology controls run by the MSP; SCADA controls by the Field Technician
gap: No technology controls on the SCADA side (patching, boundary, monitoring)
remediation: Firewall, replacement host, EDR (POAM-002, POAM-008, POAM-009)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Three policies approved 2026-08-31
gap: Procedures (last-day checklist, OT change log, vendor checklist) not yet in use
remediation: Publish the procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: MFA on SaaS and the bank; role-based production accounting
gap: Integrator access shared and without MFA; shared HMI login; remote desktop exposed until 2026-08-11
remediation: MFA session tool for vendors; named HMI accounts (POAM-001, POAM-005)

control_description: Accounts created on verbal request
gap: No approval or procedure before accounts are created
remediation: Account procedure (POAM-005)

control_description: Departures handled for email only
gap: Mobile viewer access lasted 4 months after a departure; shared passwords never changed; Geology folder open to all
remediation: Last-day checklist; quarterly review; restrict the Geology folder (POAM-005, POAM-006)

control_description: Main office keyed with alarm; field office locked; facilities fenced; cabinets padlocked; SaaS data centers under vendor SOC 2
gap: Gate code not changed after the March 2026 departure
remediation: Quarterly and post-departure gate code change

control_description: Paper shredded; no device disposal records
gap: Two old laptops given to staff in 2025 without wiping
remediation: Wipe or certified destruction with records (POL-04 4.8)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Main-office firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic
gap: Flat field office network; remote desktop port forward found 2026-08-11
remediation: IT/OT firewall; quarterly external scan (POAM-002)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS to SaaS; MDM on phones
gap: Owner exports emailed as plain attachments; USB drives used on the SCADA host
remediation: Encrypted send; USB control (POL-04 4.2; POL-02 C.3)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: MSP antivirus on office computers
gap: SCADA host signatures months old; engineering laptop unprotected; alerts seen only in business hours
remediation: EDR with after-hours alerts (POAM-009)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: MSP patch reports for office computers
gap: No vulnerability scanning; SCADA host unsupported; no OT inventory
remediation: Quarterly external scan; replacement host; OT inventory (POAM-008, POAM-010)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: None beyond antivirus
gap: No log review or monitoring
remediation: Monthly log review; EDR (POAM-009)

control_description: Incident log started 2026-09-01 (POL-03 4.3)
gap: No events evaluated yet
remediation: Use the log for every report

control_description: POL-03 and the P08 runbook approved 2026-08-31
gap: Untested
remediation: Tabletop with the MSP and integrator (POAM-012)

control_description: Cloud backup of office computers (30 days); SCADA host on an attached USB drive
gap: No isolated SCADA backup; no restore ever tested
remediation: Rotated offline drives; quarterly restore tests (POAM-003, POAM-004)

control_description: MSP changes office devices under its contract
gap: No change control for SCADA or controllers; vendor changed field settings without approval
remediation: OT change log approved by the Field Superintendent

control_description: Emergency response plan with manual operations; cyber insurance
gap: No cyber section in the emergency response plan
remediation: Contingency annex (P02 CP-2)

gap: No security terms with the integrator, SCADA vendor, or MSP; no oversight
